final: WITH by_type AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(b.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event COLLATE BINARY WHERE b.spent <> 0 GROUP BY e.type), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM by_type) SELECT bt.event_type, bt.avg_ratio, bt.avg_ratio - o.avg_ratio FROM by_type AS bt CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
